_about: Public facts copied by hand from each featured creator's YouTube channel page, used on their creator page. 'checked' is the date the numbers were read; they are a snapshot, refresh before outreach if old. 'quote' must be the creator's own words from their channel description, short. 'possessive' is his/her/their, used in the page text.

Adam Enfroy.quote: I created this channel to combat all of the “guru” clickbait on YouTube that promises too much, delivers too little, and makes you feel bad by comparison.
